info.title: pclio - read, inspect and convert point cloud files
info.description: Command line tool that inspects point cloud files, lists their scans, prints sample points and exports to LAS, XYZ, PTS, JSON or an IOScene scene.

commands.name: E57
commands.description: by signature, any extension

options.name: --scan
options.description: points only: read one scan by 0-based index, id or name (default: all scans)

options.name: --limit
options.description: Maximum number of points, an integer >= 1 (points: default 1000; export: default all)

options.name: --step
options.description: Subsampling step, an integer >= 1 (default 1)

options.name: --no-transform
options.description: Return coordinates as stored, without the scan transform

options.name: --force
options.description: export only: replace an existing output file

options.name: --json
options.description: info and scans: print JSON

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help and exit

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show the version and exit
Exit codes (one line on standard error, no stack trace):
0  success
1  wrong command line: unknown option, missing or extra argument, invalid value, output refused
2  input cannot be read (missing, empty or unreadable) or the output file cannot be written
3  input is corrupt, truncated or unsupported
4  unexpected internal failure

commands.name: BIN
commands.description: binary point cloud entities by the CCB2 signature (.bin)

commands.name: COPC
commands.description: Cloud Optimized Point Cloud, a LAS 1.4 copc record (.copc.laz)

commands.name: EdgeWise
commands.description: the extension .c3db or .c3ptx, or a text or tree signature in another file

commands.name: EPT
commands.description: Entwine Point Tile datasets (ept.json, ept-hierarchy/, ept-data/)

commands.name: export
commands.description:
Write points to a file. The output is written to a temporary file next to the
target and moved into place when complete. Export refuses to write to the input
path and refuses to replace an existing file unless --force is given.

commands.name: scan
commands.description: an OLE2 compound file with the extension .fls, or a folder with a FARO scan layout

commands.name: info
commands.description: Print format, file size, scan count, point count, bounds, coordinate system, metadata and warnings.

commands.name: json
commands.description:
export: metadata and scans; with --limit also the first n points (--step and --no-transform are rejected)
points: one JSON object per line with x, y, z, intensity, r, g, b (null when the point lacks a value)

commands.name: LAS
commands.description: ASPRS LAS 1.2, point data record format 2 (XYZ, intensity, RGB)

commands.name: LAZ
commands.description: LASzip compressed LAS by signature and a valid LASzip record (.laz)

commands.name: PTG
commands.description: by the PTG signature and magic, or a 'PTG index' header with the extension .ptg

commands.name: scan
commands.description: by signature; .lgs selects the older container, any other extension .lgsx

commands.name: PCD
commands.description: by header structure (.pcd)

commands.name: PinPoint
commands.description:
a JSON text file with the extension .smf or .srf, or a folder that holds
ScanProject.json, a .smf file or a .srf file

commands.name: PLY
commands.description: by header structure (.ply)

commands.name: points
commands.description:
Print points to standard output. At most 1000 points unless --limit is given.
With --format xyz or pts the lines are the same as in the exported file.

commands.name: Potree
commands.description: Potree octree point clouds (cloud.js, metadata.json, .hrc, .bin)

commands.name: PTS
commands.description: a line with the point count followed by point lines, or point lines with the extension .pts

commands.name: PTX
commands.description: by header structure: grid dimensions, scanner pose and transformation matrix (.ptx)

commands.name: scan
commands.description:
by signature (.rcs)
ReCap project a ZIP archive with the extension .rcp

commands.name: SBF
commands.description:
Simple Binary Format with a companion header (.sbf, .sbf.data)
3D Tiles      OGC 3D Tiles point clouds and glTF point primitives (.pnts, .glb, tileset.json)

commands.name: scans
commands.description: List the scans with point counts, available channels, bounds and translation.

commands.name: scene
commands.description:
IOScene scene JSON (also inferred from the extension .scene.json): one element per scan, point geometry
in metres, scan properties as text. Per-point colour, intensity and classification are not part of
IOScene 0.1.0 and are reported on standard error. At most 1,000,000 points unless --limit is given;
--no-transform is rejected. Conversion notes and warnings go to standard error.
las, xyz, pts and the json export skip points with a NaN or infinite coordinate; the count is reported on
standard error. 'points --format json' writes every point; such coordinates appear as the strings "NaN",
"Infinity" and "-Infinity".
No output format stores normals, except scene, which keeps them when every point of a scan has one.

commands.name: XYZ
commands.description: ASCII lines "X Y Z", followed by "R G B" when the point has a colour, otherwise by the intensity when it has one

commands.description: binary point cloud entities by the CCB2 signature (.bin)

commands.name: scene
commands.description:
IOScene scene JSON (also inferred from the extension .scene.json): one element per scan, point geometry
in metres, scan properties as text. Per-point colour, intensity and classification are not part of
IOScene 0.1.0 and are reported on standard error. At most 1,000,000 points unless --limit is given;
--no-transform is rejected. Conversion notes and warnings go to standard error.
las, xyz, pts and the json export skip points with a NaN or infinite coordinate; the count is reported on
standard error. 'points --format json' writes every point; such coordinates appear as the strings "NaN",
"Infinity" and "-Infinity".
No output format stores normals, except scene, which keeps them when every point of a scan has one.
